prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a small floating eyeball creature: a round white eyeball with a big blue iris and a black pupil, red veins, two small translucent blue fish fins on its sides and a short forked blue tail fin behind it; it hovers, nothing touches the ground; in every cell it floats at the same height in its box with clear empty space below it. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the blue iris and pupil are the face; no mouth.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, darting forward toward the heroes, the iris staring wide, the fins swept back, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the eye squeezed half shut, the fins folding, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Keep the frontal view in every cell: the big eye faces the viewer with its iris looking toward the heroes on the right, never turned to a side profile; in the attack the whole body darts forward to the right, level; in the hurt it is knocked back to the left and tilted back by about fifteen degrees; it always hovers, nothing touches the ground; the fins and the tail fin move with the motion. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a mouth, teeth, eyestalks, tentacles, a crown, legs.
